example.title: Wesley Methodist Church, 201 North Fifth Street
example.source: HABS WI-278 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,28-WATO,2-)

brief: German Methodist church of 1869 (demolished 1978): a gable-front brick nave with tall pointed-arch windows along the sides and a pointed-arch entrance, and a square frame bell tower rising from the front gable in two stages to an octagonal belfry and slender spire with a cross. Set on a corner lot with trees, the parsonage next door.
